questions: Which of b2, b4 and b6 is most important for n4 meeting its system requirement?

clarification.question: Which mathematical meaning of most important should I use?

choices.label: Forced outage
choices.definition: P(F | do(B_i=0), H): system failure when bridge i is forced closed (its edge closed); other bridges retain their scenario uncertainty.

choices.label: Availability comparison
choices.definition: P(F | do(B_i=0), H) and P(F | do(B_i=1), H), reported separately for each bridge.

choices.label: Diagnostic association
choices.definition: P(B_i=0 | F, H): bridge i is closed given an observed system failure; this is not a causal effect.

must_not: Choose an importance definition without asking
Run probability queries before the user selects a definition
